description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various model configurations across two datasets, labeled "PHEME" on the left and partially labeled "Poli..." on the right. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 92.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The horizontal category axis displays the model configurations, which are grouped by dataset and separated by a vertical dashed line. Within each of the two dataset groups, there are six bars representing different configurations, each distinguished by color: "Ours" in dark red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in light yellow, "w/o select" in light blue, "w/o emotion" in medium blue, and "w/o cognition" in dark blue. Every bar is annotated at its top with its exact numerical value. In the "PHEME" group, the values are 89.84 for "Ours", 86.82 for "w/o comments", 80.10 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 88.80 for "w/o select", 87.34 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 for "w/o cognition". In the right-hand group, the values are 90.57 for "Ours" (the tallest bar overall), 85.85 for "w/o comments", 83.02 for "w/o text", 89.62 for "w/o select", 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.74 for "w/o cognition". The bars are not sorted by height but follow a consistent categorical order across both groups. The entire chart is visually presented at a tilted angle, and horizontal dashed grid lines extend from the vertical axis across the plot area.
